a.xlink:title: identity Supabase managed identity + 1:1 extension (PII živi SAMO u auth.users)
accounts_and_orgs GitHub-style unified accounts. Slug je immutable u v1. Soft-delete samo na accounts.
activity_log ★ NOVO u v3 — append-only event stream. Seam za notifications/audit/feed.
domovina_ai Netflix-style watch state + favorites + curated playlists

auth.users
**Supabase managed** — ne mijenjamo schemu.
★ **Princip 1:** Sva PII (email, OAuth identifiers, telefon, raw metadata) lives ONLY here. Druge tablice drže pointer (FK) i non-PII data.
GDPR "delete my data" = DELETE FROM auth.users → ON DELETE CASCADE riješi sve ostalo. Single audit point.

profiles
User-specific NON-PII app context. 1:1 s auth.users via trigger.
v3 change: drop `email` i `is_anonymous` mirror. Koristi `auth.email()` i `auth.jwt() ->> 'is_anonymous'` u queries.

accounts
**★ Central abstraction** — owner = user ili org.
Princip 2: slug je IMMUTABLE u v1. Trigger BEFORE UPDATE odbija promjenu slug-a. Slug history se može dodati kasnije ako bude need.
Princip 3: deleted_at — JEDINA tablica s soft-delete. Sve drugo hard-delete preko ON DELETE CASCADE. Cleanup cron periodični hard-delete starije od 30 dana.
search_text GENERATED stupac kombinira name + slug + bio za fuzzy typeahead "find user/org" — GIN trigram index daje sub-ms search čak na milijun redaka.

accounts_memberships
N:M user × org × role. Personal account NEMA membership red (user JE primary_owner_user_id direktno).
v3: nepromijenjen od v2. role_permissions tablica je uklonjena — hierarchy owner > admin > member je hardcoded u has_role_on_account() helper f-ji.

invitations
Pending state između "pozvan" i "član". Email-based jer pozvani možda još nije user.
**Izuzetak od Principa 1:** invitations.email je nužno PII — pozvani user ne mora postojati u auth.users yet.
Tablica se dodaje u Fazi 8, ne u MVP-u.

activity_events
**★ Architectural seam za 4 buduća features-a:**
1. Notifications feed ("Ana joined your org") 2. Audit log (compliance — "kad je promijenjen role?") 3. What's new feed (per-account activity stream) 4. Recommendations training (anonimizirana watch completion)
**Strategija:** writes se postavljaju od DANA 1 (Faza 0) preko log_event() helpera + triggera. Reads (UI feed) dolazi u Fazi 7+. Backlog povijesti je gotov kad UI bude potreban.
Event type vocabulary (početni): org.created, member.invited, member.invite_accepted, member.joined, member.role_changed, member.removed, account.deleted, episode.completed
ON DELETE CASCADE na target_account_id (audit nestane s accountom). ON DELETE SET NULL na actor_user_id (event ostaje, actor je anoniman).

domovina_ai.watch_progress
**★ Najvažnija tablica.** Denormalizirano "GDJE si stao" stanje.
v3 change: dodani episode_title + episode_thumbnail_url. Klijent ih piše u istom upsert tick-u (već zna title/thumbnail iz CDN data za reprodukciju). Skida sekundarni fetch za "Continue watching" carousel — single Postgres query daje cijeli UI state.
Stale risk: ako CDN rename-a title, naš cache je stale do sljedećeg gledanja. Prihvatljivo trade-off.

domovina_ai.watch_sessions
Append-only audit log gledanja. Za analytics, NE za UI resume.
v3: nepromijenjen od v2.

domovina_ai.bookmarks
Privatni timestamp markeri korisnika u epizodi.
v3: nepromijenjen od v2. Dodaje se u Fazi 10, ne u MVP-u.

domovina_ai.favorites
Quick-save lista epizoda. Owner = user (osobno) ili org (team-kurirano).
v3: nepromijenjen od v2. Dodaje se u Fazi 10.

domovina_ai.playlists
Kuratirana lista epizoda — može biti private, members-only, ili public.
v3 change: drop forked_from_id (speculativni feature). Re-add kad fork UI postoji.
domovina_ai.playlist_items N:M epizoda × playlist s manual position ordering.
